name: amazon_ads-mcp
display_name: Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products / Brands / Display) MCP
description: Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products / Brands / Display) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_

platform_mcp_amazon_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_ads_client_id.description: Login with Amazon client id of the app approved for the Amazon Ads API; also sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId header.

platform_mcp_amazon_ads_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_amazon_ads_client_secret.description: The LWA client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

platform_mcp_amazon_ads_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_amazon_ads_refresh_token.description: LWA refresh token from the advertiser's consent (scope advertising::campaign_management); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token.

platform_mcp_amazon_ads_api_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_API_HOST
platform_mcp_amazon_ads_api_host.description: Regional Amazon Ads API host: advertising-api.amazon.com (North America), advertising-api-eu.amazon.com (Europe) or advertising-api-fe.amazon.com (Far East).

platform_mcp_amazon_ads_profile_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_PROFILE_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_ads_profile_id.description: Advertising profile id (one per advertiser and marketplace, from GET /v2/profiles), sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header.

platform_mcp_amazon_ads_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_ENV
platform_mcp_amazon_ads_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_amazon_ads_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_amazon_ads_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/profiles/{profileId}: the configured profile {profileId, countryCode, currencyCode, timezone, accountInfo {id, type, name, marketplaceStringId}}.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v2/profiles (apiProgram=campaign, accessLevel=edit by default): one profile per advertiser and marketplace in the configured region. `id` is the profileId used as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope; country is raw.countryCode.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Sponsored Products v3 POST /sp/campaigns/list with Content-Type/Accept application/vnd.spCampaign.v3+json and {maxResults, stateFilter: {include: [status]}} (ENABLED, PAUSED, ARCHIVED). The advertiser is the configured profile_id (Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header): account_id is not sent and should be that profile id. `budget` is budget.budget in the profile currency (budgetType DAILY). Paging is by nextToken; only the first page is returned.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /sp/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, budget: {budget, budgetType: DAILY}}]} in the profile's currency (`currency` is ignored). The API answers 207 Multi-Status with campaigns.success[] / campaigns.error[]; a rejected update (error only) is reported as invalid_input.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /sp/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, state: PAUSED|ENABLED}]}; 207 Multi-Status, the success item carries the updated campaign (status = its state); a rejected update is reported as invalid_input.
